$comment: Licence policy for components shipped in the product (docs/adr/0002-licence-policy.md). Read by scripts/check_licences.py (Python) and scripts/check_npm_licences.mjs (web). Development and test tools that never ship are reported, not gated.

psycopg.reason: The PostgreSQL driver Django supports. Used unmodified as a separately installed library.

psycopg-binary.reason: Binary build of psycopg, same terms. Used unmodified.

psycopg-pool.reason: Connection pool from the psycopg project, pulled in by procrastinate. Used unmodified.

pyphen.reason: Hyphenation used by WeasyPrint. Offered under GPL, LGPL or MPL 1.1; GSA takes it under MPL 1.1, unmodified.
